messages:
Alex W: kicked off kernel sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S this morning — seq sweep [64,128,256,512,1024], batch sweep [1,2,4,8]. results uploaded to the perf bucket.
PerfBot: summary uploaded: https://s3.redwood/prefetch/bench-1769004321.csv :page_with_curl:
Maria G: quick note — H100 paged-flash variant shows unexpected throughput drop at seq=512, batch=2. ~25% lower than A100 for same config.
Kevin L: <eyes> any env differences? cuda/driver/torch versions?
Alex W: same AMI + driver (525.85), TF/torch pins identical. ran multiple seeds.
Sana R: I pulled nsight traces for the H100 paged-flash run. attaching snip: ```
# nsight snippet
Kernel: paged_flash_attention
sm_eff: 62%
stall_mem: 18%
l2_miss: 12%
memory_bw: 720 GB/s
```
Maria G: for A100 same kernel looked like: ```
Kernel: paged_flash_attention
sm_eff: 74%
stall_mem: 8%
l2_miss: 5%
memory_bw: 910 GB/s
```
Kevin L: interesting — looks like memory bandwidth cliff on H100 for that kernel/seq combo. could be PTX/kern selection that causes non-coalesced loads when pages misalign.
Alex W: agreed. also saw increased KV cache churn in H100 runs: effective cache hits dropped ~7% at seq=512, likely because paged layout crosses page boundaries more often.
Sana R: batching heuristics got us here — small batches + long sequences cause many partial pages. proposal: prefer group-by-prefix-length before packing to keep pages aligned.
Maria G: sounds good. any quick mitigation? I can flip kernel selector to prefer fused_flash for H100 when seq>=512 and batch<=2. That gave stable throughput in local tests.
Alex W: do it as opt-in flag first. we should also add perf regression test in CI that runs the H100 seq sweep on a lightweight sample.
DeployBot: deploy started for branch: perf/h100-fallback-flag — CI: 1/3, smoke checks running.
PerfBot: regression numbers (post-flag): H100 paged_flash fallback to fused_flash at seq>=512 restores throughput to within 5% of A100 baseline. full logs: https://s3.redwood/perf/1769004321/fallback-results.log
Kevin L: long term fix is to investigate kernel codegen for paged-flash on H100 (PTX scheduling + ldg patterns). I'll open a kernel-debug issue and assign.
Maria G: filed: https://issues.redwood/INFR-812 — assigned Kevin. added nsight traces and perf csv.
Alex W: followups: (1) add grouping-by-seq to packing heuristics (Sana), (2) land opt-in fallback flag (Maria), (3) kernel debug issue (Kevin). let's sync tomorrow after CI runs. :thumbsup:
Sana R: will prototype packing change today, then run seq/batch sweep overnight on H100 pool.
Maria G: CI passed on opt-in flag. rolling canary to dedicated infra at 10% traffic.
Alex W: great. if canary is green we'll flip default for H100 and add notes to rollout doc.
DeployBot: canary metrics: latency P99 improved, throughput normalized. canary window: 30m.
Kevin L: attaching a short checklist to debug INFR-812: reproduce, isolate kernel IR, test different block sizes, compare memory access patterns between A100/H100.
Maria G: thanks — feel free to ping me for logs. :pray:
Alex W: thanks all. summary will go into the eng-runtime perf board.
